title: Duplicate financial events declare identity and payload compatibility
question: Compare event-ID scope, conflicting duplicate payloads, delivery ordering and atomic marker creation.

evidence.title: Webhook deduplication identifies an event before comparing its payload
explanation: An existing event ID returns before charge lookup or payload/status comparison, while the processed counter still increments. New events transition the charge, record an outbox event and then save the dedup marker. The schema declares globally unique event_id within this table.

A repeated ID with a different charge/status is ignored on this method path. Concurrent duplicates depend on the unique constraint and transaction boundary; no local conflict recovery occurs here. Delivery authentication, provider scopes, null status and event ordering remain unreviewed or undefined at this boundary.
